2607.24074.title: MiSS: A Logic-Driven Explanation of Minimal Sufficient Coalitions for Point Cloud Classifiers
2607.24074.paper_summary: We present MiSS, a black-box, query-based framework for explaining 3D point cloud classifiers through perturbation-relative sufficiency reasoning. MiSS treats a superpoint partition as an interpretable abstraction layer and asks whether the original prediction can be certified from a minimal coalition of geometric regions under a specified perturbation distribution. Unlike abductive explainers that require Boolean feature spaces or white-box logical encodings of the predictor, MiSS separates candidate proposal from verification: a weighted MaxSAT procedure proposes coalitions using a heuristic adaptive cardinality floor, certified exact-size fallback, a safely tightened upper bound, blocking clauses, and a surrogate acquisition heuristic learned from previous oracle evaluations, while a blackbox statistical oracle decides sufficiency from prediction queries. The system returns a statistically verified sufficient coalition as a binary attribution, with minimum cardinality guaranteed when certified search completes. Experiments on ModelNet40 and ShapeNet with PointNet and PointMLP classifiers show higher precision and coverage than rule-based baselines in most settings, with lower explanation time than exhaustive search.
2607.24074.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 MiSS，一個基於查詢的黑箱框架，通過擾動相對充分性推理來解釋 3D 點雲分類器。MiSS 將超點劃分視為可解釋的抽象層，並詢問在指定的擾動分佈下，是否可以從最小的幾何區域聯盟中證實原始預測。與需要布爾特徵空間或預測器的白箱邏輯編碼的推理解釋器不同，MiSS 將候選提案與驗證分開：一個加權的 MaxSAT 程序使用啟發式自適應基數下限、經過認證的確切大小回退、安全收緊的上限、阻塞子句以及從先前的 oracle 評估中學習的替代獲取啟發式來提出聯盟，而黑箱統計 oracle 根據預測查詢決定充分性。系統返回一個統計上驗證的充分聯盟作為二元歸因，當認證搜索完成時，保證最小基數。對 ModelNet40 和 ShapeNet 進行的實驗顯示，使用 PointNet 和 PointMLP 分類器在大多數設置中比基於規則的基準具有更高的精度和覆蓋率，並且解釋時間比全面搜索更短。
2607.24074.author: Mengda Xing et.al.
